faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RGU CRS Project Fellow (Junior)-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to send your application via email for the RGU CRS Project Fellow (Junior)-I position is 30th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the CRS Project Fellow (Junior)-I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the CRS Project Fellow (Junior)-I post at Rajiv Gandhi University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an MSc in Chemistry with a minimum of 55% marks, obtained not earlier than 3 years from the application date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the CRS Project Fellow (Junior)-I position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is ₹14,000/- per month plus HRA at 10%.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this RGU recruitment?
faq.answer: You need to apply via email by sending your complete bio-data and self-attested copies of required documents before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the CRS Project Fellow (Junior)-I post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the CRS Project Fellow (Junior)-I position is scheduled for 1st September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Rajiv Gandhi University located?
faq.answer: Rajiv Gandhi University is located in Doimukh, Arunachal Pradesh, with the pincode 791112.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is RGU/PC/UGC-DAE(III)/687/Md.HR/2026.
